property_name: Four Points by Sheraton Nagoya, Chubu International Airport
note: First overseas acquisition. Purchase price JPY 6,000 million (=approx S$56.5m acquisition of investment property per cash flow). Valuation as at 31 Dec 2025 JPY 7,790 million. Funded by term loans (JPY 5.9bn), RCF (JPY 364.9m) and a 4-year TMK bond (JPY 0.5bn).
